clips.title: The story
paras: In Ratchet, Menara Voidrender teaches warlocks from both factions the dark arts. The human warlock shares her knowledge of demon-binding artifacts and arcane craft from a refuge in Kalimdor, far from orthodox authorities.

Menara Voidrender works from Ratchet, the neutral goblin port in the Barrens. Many warlocks in the Eastern Kingdoms study in cellars or hidden slaughterhouses beneath their cities, but Ratchet keeps Menara away from the Kirin Tor, Stormwind's guards, and Orgrimmar's overseers. There, she can pursue occult studies in plain sight. She teaches any capable apprentice, whatever their faction, making her a rare meeting point for practitioners of the dark arts.

Veteran conjurers know Menara as an authority on orbs that imprison and harness demonic spirits. She works with intricate reagents and guides apprentices through demanding rituals to make enchanted attire and binding implements. Her skill is known as far as Ironforge and the Undercity, and senior warlocks across Azeroth send their most promising students across the sea to seek her counsel.
